summary_en: 150,800 shares (4.25% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) to be acquired up to ¥301.6M total via open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange from Jun 8 to Nov 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On June 5, 2026, BRIDGE International Group's board of directors resolved to initiate a treasury stock acquisition program. The company will acquire up to 150,800 ordinary shares (4.25% of shares outstanding, calculated as of April 30, 2026 when 3,542,400 shares were issued excluding treasury) for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥301.6 million. Purchases will be executed via open-market trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from June 8, 2026 to November 30, 2026. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions.
